inputs.prompt: Keep everything in image 1 exactly as it is: the same room, the same camera position and framing, the same light, and the same man asleep in the bed, who has not moved. Add one new element: a luminous double of the sleeping man is sitting up out of his body. The double is an exact copy of the man shown in image 2 and image 3, who is also the man asleep in the bed: the same face, the same short dark hair and trimmed beard, the same warm medium-brown skin, the same dark charcoal T-shirt. He is made of light: his body is softly luminous and partly see-through, so the dark wall and the pillow show faintly through him, with a thin bright rim of pale mint-green light (#b7f4cf) all along his outline, as if lit from behind, and a fine shimmer of tiny mint light particles around him. His face and skin keep their own natural brown colour under the glow, and his clothes keep their own dark colours; only the rim, the shimmer and the soft glow he casts are mint. He has risen halfway: his head, shoulders and chest are upright above the sleeper, while his waist and legs are still merged inside the sleeping body under the duvet. His face is turned three-quarters toward the camera, with open eyes and a calm, gentle, awake expression. His glow falls softly on the pillow, the duvet and the wall behind him. He looks friendly and capable, never ghostly or frightening. There are exactly two figures in the room: one solid and asleep in the bed, one made of light. Photorealistic, like a frame from a premium advertising film. Nothing written anywhere.
